subject: Payment consolidation request — INV-8472 (wire fallback)
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Price <lauren.price@aurelia.com>, accounts-payable <ap@aurelia.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Payment consolidation request — INV-8472 (wire fallback)

Hi Lauren / AP team,

Hope you had a good week. Quick follow on INV-8472 (PO 9921) — the invoice is due next week and accounting flagged that the client-side card token expired on your side. We prefer ACH (same-entity routing) to avoid wire fees, but understand some banks are limiting ACH for new vendors.

Can you confirm:
- Whether you can process an ACH by EOD 3 Jul?
- If not, will you initiate a wire? If wire, we can provide Zelle/wire instructions below and push for a one-time fee waiver.

Attached: Invoice_INV-8472.pdf for quick reference. If you need our W-9 or proof of entity mapping, I can attach that immediately.

If it helps, we can accept a split remit (wire for outstanding balance, card for subscription moving forward) — please confirm the preferred routing so we can coordinate with Finance.

Thanks — aiming to close this before month-end to avoid escalation.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0123

Attachment: Invoice_INV-8472.pdf

Date: Mon, 03 Jul 2028 10:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Payment consolidation request — INV-8472 (wire fallback)

Diego — thanks for the note.

Quick update from AP: the corporate card payment bounced during token refresh (gateway returned card_expired). Our treasury team is unable to add new vendor ACH rails because our bank has a temporary onboarding block for vendors that require international routing verification.

We can do a wire on Tue 5 Jul. We will need:
- Your wire instructions (bank name, routing, account ending)
- Redwood's W-9 (or US tax form) for our records
- A remittance reference to map to INV-8472 (so our ERP picks this up)

I attached our signed W-9 (W9_Aurelia_signed.pdf) for your records (we included entity confirmation). I know wires can trigger AML, so if you have a preferred remittance descriptor please advise — we want to minimize routing delays.

Thanks,
Lauren Price
Director, Finance Operations
Aurelia Therapeutics
ap@aurelia.com

Attachment: W9_Aurelia_signed.pdf
